title: web paged summary record (v1)
description: The terminal record of a successful multi-request web pagination run: the deduplicated result count, the requested page budget, the pages received, the duplicates removed, and the most recent exchange's status and identifiers. Per-request metadata, including each pacing wait, lives in the JSON envelope's upstream array, not in JSONL records. The single-request page and upstream_offset fields are deliberately absent: with several pages they are ambiguous, and each result record carries its own page provenance.
